Phone Case I Made With Felt, Embroidery, and Buttons (album in comments)

This was a playful project I made for a friend's birthday. She's a photographer so I made her a little camera motif. I tweaked a design originally created by this artist.

Here's an album of project at different stages: https://sli.mg/a/LlFIRe

The yellow/orange felt is heavy duty. I had to use an awl to pierce big enough holes for the needle and thread to pass through.

The other felt shapes were regular craft felts. I first made the pattern pieces out of paper then traced the shapes onto craft felt. That way I can make another if I want because I still have the template shapes.

I stitched the sides together with wool embroidery floss.

I attached a button on the back as a closure but forgot to take pictures of it.
